title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1604: Su yus acting skill (2)

section.p: Su Yu laughed and said, “There are nine petals in total. What’s the big deal about feeding him one? It’s not like the skylotus is that useful for me.”
Someone shouted, “Su Yu, that is a supreme treasure capable of helping one achieve Daofuse! If you’re not using it for yourself, Great Qin King…”

Su Yu said, “It’s mine. I can do what I want to it. There is no need for you to offer your opinion. Also, with one of the petals damaged, only eight remain. That is no longer sufficient to help someone achieve Daofuse.”
He snorted with disdain before grinning again as he stuffed the petal into the little furball’s mouth. He said, “We have seven petals left. Don’t worry, we can eat more later.”
The little furball started glowing.
Su Yu smiled and stuffed the furball back into his head. But with that, his head started glowing.
Everyone was dumbstruck.
Bullshit!
What a bastard!
A petal from the nine-leaf skylotus was worth as much as a carrier treasure! This bastard had nonchalantly fed it to a furball! And he intended to do the same with the rest!
Bastard!
The Invincibles cursed inwardly, while the Sunmoons were completely stupefied.
What was going on? Feeding his pet with the nine-leaf skylotus?
The Sunmoons roared inwardly. If Su Yu didn’t want the skylotus, he could always throw it on the ground. They would gladly pick it up. How could he waste it like this?
As for Great Qin King, he was first furious. But soon, he blanked out.
Eight petals?
Was he blind? He remembered receiving three from Su Yu previously.
How was Su Yu supposed to have eight petals? What was this guy doing?

Su Yu maintained an indifferent expression, but inside his head, the little furball was shouting pitifully, “What was that? It was terrible! That thing was so bitter! Disgusting! How can you bully me when my mama is here!”
Su Yu said, “Don’t worry. I’ll pay you when I make some money. Senior, this is nothing. The little furball is like a brother of mine. I always share what I make with him. Am I right, Furball?”
The little furball said, “Fine, fine. But tell me in advance the next time you do something like this!”

Su Yu couldn’t be bothered to reply. The little furball had grown a lot more demanding as of late. Just look at how the little furball was talking back at him. Did the furball think that his mama would be with them forever?

Noticing that everyone was staring at him, Su Yu laughed and asked, “What is it? Your Majesty, let’s continue. Why are you looking at me like that? Are you interested in buying one from me? Sure, I’ll give you a cheap price. Three carrier treasures or an Invincible corpse per petal.”
Great Qin King answered stiffly, “No. One petal won’t do much for me.”
Su Yu said, “Exactly. Like I said, the remaining petals are useless for achieving Daofuse. The rumors have exaggerated the power of the skylotus.”
Great Zhou King laughed and said, “Mayor Su, the skylotus is still quite useful in its complete form. What a pity.”
Su Yu nodded, “Indeed. Blood Fire damaged one of the petals. As punishment, I killed him. That fellow insisted on ruining what he couldn’t get. He was simply courting death.”
Great Zhou King gave Su Yu a deep gaze and said, “Mayor Su, you sure are generous with the crown prince of the soul devourers. A single petal is more than enough to get you a carrier treasure.”
Su Yu said, “I don’t need more carrier treasures. I already have plenty.”

A floating book appeared above his palm. With a smile, he said, “Aren’t there rumors out there claiming that I am forging a demonic weapon? The rumors are right. I have used forty carrier treasures for this weapon so far.”
“Hu…”
The breathing in the area intensified.
Was this real?

Great Zhou King glanced at the book, but he didn’t inspect further, as that would be the same as a provocation. He merely focused on it slightly before nodding, “An excellent weapon. Was this the same weapon that had produced a heavenly tribulation? Demonic weapon? So be it. Demonic or saintly, a weapon is only meant for killing. It doesn’t matter. But this weapon of yours is indeed quite expensive to make.”

Su Yu chuckled and said, “It’s no big deal. I have only used forty carrier treasures and a few Invincible corpses so far. But this weapon will only be useful after becoming a divine weapon. For now, my fists are better.”
Everyone was rendered speechless. They kept having a feeling that Su Yu was here to brag about his wealth. He was too damn rich.
This was madness. Forging a weapon with so many carrier treasures? The same number of carrier treasures could have produced twenty new Invincibles.
Madman!
Even Great Qin King was too distracted to think about the nine-leaf skylotus anymore. He looked at the book and said, “How many carrier treasures do you intend to forge into your book?”

“Ten thousand.” Su Yu said, “I wouldn’t mind having more, and I could also settle with a little bit less. It doesn’t matter. Naturally, I would never say no to more carrier treasures. Do you have any to offer, Your Majesty? I have enough treasures to trade for like three or even five of them.”
As he said that, he took out two dragonblood fruit trees, a grain of riversand as big as a millstone, and a solidwater pearl as big as a hill. Then, he took countless dragonbind wood out.
Su Yu smiled and said, “This is one of the reasons I’m here. I wish to buy more carrier treasures from you, Your Majesty.”
Great Qin King was rendered speechless. Everyone else was rendered speechless as well. The Invincibles were greatly shocked. Just how much did this kid earn from the Luminous Domain Mansion?
These treasures…there were too many of them!
If it weren’t for their reason holding back, they would have robbed Su Yu by now. He was so rich that robbing him would be the shortcut to getting rich overnight.

After a long while, Great Qin King said, “No. We need all the carrier treasures we can get to help more of our Sunmoons advance. We still have a large number of Sunmoons stuck due to a lack of carrier treasures.”

Su Yu laughed and said, “That’s easy to solve. Just do what I did. Kill dozens of Invincibles and you will get a decent number of carrier treasures. Are you interested in doing a big job, Your Majesty? We can share the spoils at a 30:70 split. What do you say?”
Great Qin King was rendered speechless yet again.
Do a big job. And a 30:70 split.
But the kid was so rich that he didn’t even feel like sharing anything with the kid anymore.
Great Qin King said, “Forget it. We’ll deal with this ourselves.”
Looking at the big millstone behind Su Yu, Great Xia King asked, “Is that millstone…riversand?”
“Yes.”
“Uhm…are you selling it?”
Su Yu smiled and said, “We can talk about this later. Your Majesty, are you thinking of using it for the Willpower Grotto? We can discuss this privately.”
Great Xia King laughed happily and said, “Sure!”
Su Yu laughed as well. Why was this guy so happy? The Willpower Grotto was his.

The other Invincibles were stirring as well. Heavenly Forge King asked, “Are you selling the dragonbind wood? The ones you have here are not at the level of heaven weapons, but I can forge them into heaven weapons. I can agree to a 30:70…no, even a 20:80 split!”
He looked at Su Yu expectantly.

When he saw that Su Yu was staying silent, he said, “10:90 will do as well! Generally, anyone hiring me to forge a heaven weapon will need to prepare two sets of materials. I’ll take one set as the fee. This time, I’m only taking ten percent of the materials!”

Su Yu laughed and said, “There is no need to trouble you. These materials are meant for my teacher’s practice. As a weaponsmith, practice is important. After trying a few hundred times, I reckon my teacher would become a heaven weaponsmith as well. Thanks for the offer, Heavenly Forge King.”
Heavenly Forge King was on the verge of losing his mind.

He hurriedly said, “Zhao Li? Yes, he did benefit from the previous forging session. But he’s still a peak earth weaponsmith. He’s not strong enough to make use of these materials. At least half of them would be wasted in his hands! It’s not worth producing a heaven weaponsmith with such valuable materials!”
Su Yu said, “It doesn’t matter. I don’t care about such trash materials. I believe my teacher can advance after a few hundred attempts.”

Su Yu continued, “If you wish to forge something out of these materials as well…I can give you a set or two later. But you must agree to forging your weapons in front of my teacher. Allow him to witness your skills and you can get the materials for free.”
Heavenly Forge King blanked out. He said with hesitation, “This…I have a different forging style. When forging heaven weapons, I’ll have to apply some of my personal techniques…”
Su Yu chuckled, “Forget it, then.”

Since the Heavenly Forge King was unwilling, so be it. But if Heavenly Forge King agreed, things would get very interesting. After all, when forging a heaven weapon, he would need to use all his strength and reveal any bloodline he potentially had.
Heavenly Forge King was one of the suspects. Yes, weaponsmithing was a private affair, but the issue wouldn’t be too big as long as it wasn’t a dao weapon.
Heavenly Forge King gnashed his teeth and said, “Fine! You will supply the materials and I will keep the completed weapon. Do you agree?”

“Yes.” Su Yu said, “This won’t be an issue. This will be a valuable experience for my teacher’s future advancement. In fact, this will be a valuable experience for me as well. I believe I am probably good enough to forge a peak earth weapon now. As for heaven weapons, I believe I will be able to forge one after observing a few forging sessions.”

Only then did everyone recall that Su Yu was also someone who had once forged a heaven weapon. The book in his hand was a weapon he had forged himself. This signified that his weaponsmithing skills were very impressive as well.
Everyone knew his teacher as well. He was talking about Zhao Li, not Bai Feng.
A realization struck everyone. Zhao Li was going to get rich after this.
The dragonbind wood here might not be heaven materials, but they were good enough to forge new heaven weapons. And heaven weapons were good enough to serve as carrier treasures.
